messages:
maria: heads-up: i'm prepping a tiny docs PR to simplify the 429 troubleshooting example in the error reference. current section has duplicated backoff pseudocode and a dead SDK link. i'll replace with one concise JS + Python snippet, add guidance for parsing Retry-After (seconds vs http-date), and update the SDK link. PR in ~15m.
ashwin: great. please include an exact copy-pasteable JS example that uses our official SDK call and recommended retry config (max retries, capped exp backoff, jitter). a lot of users copy the old infinite-loop pattern.
kevin: also include a helper for Retry-After parsing; it's super common to get wrong. maybe `parseRetryAfter` that returns ms and handles both numeric seconds and RFC1123 dates.
maria: plan: two short examples (hosted SDK + plain fetch), plus `parseRetryAfter` helper and a note: "Prefer Retry-After header when present; if absent, use capped exponential backoff with jitter."
elaine: add a CI linkcheck job tweak — the anchor changed after the docs nav refactor, CI flagged it earlier. small note under "fallbacks" about when to prefer model variant fallbacks vs degraded quantized model would help ops. keep wording light.
doc-bot: linkcheck: broken link found "/docs/sdk/retries" -> 404 in error-reference/429.md (detected 2h ago)
maria: fixed link to `/docs/sdk/retries-guide` and pointed anchor to `#policy-examples`. opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1499
ashwin: can you paste the exact SDK call we show in hosted examples? e.g. `redwood.generate({ model: 'x-small', prompt, retry: { maxRetries: 3, baseMs: 200, capMs: 5000, jitter: true } })`. that helps support copy-paste.
sam: also can we add one sentence in runtime FAQ linking to this err-ref change? folks keep asking why context trimming happens before fallback selection. a link will reduce tickets.
maria: added runtime-FAQ link, added changelog entry, and requested @elaine review.
elaine: quick readthrough done, left a tiny wording nit. requested CI re-run. once green i'll merge and post a short blurb to #support. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all — will post update after merge.
